basic_profile.bio: I'm a 27-year-old digital artist from Seville, Spain. My passion for MMOs started in my teenage years, and I've recently rekindled my love for the genre through Tibia. When I'm not exploring virtual worlds, I enjoy delving into the works of Simon Stålenhag and discussing identity and representation on forums. I'm currently working as a freelance illustrator, which allows me flexibility with my schedule. I'm single and often online during late nights, as I find peace in the quiet hours.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My expertise lies in digital illustration, with a particular interest in sci-fi and fantasy themes. I am self-taught, having honed my skills through online tutorials and practice. My gaming knowledge is largely self-acquired through years of playing various MMORPGs.
